speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …これが ドラゴンオーブ…
original_en: This is it <PART> ---- <PART> the Dragon Orb.
translated: Aqui está <PART> ---- <PART> o Orbe do Dragão.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: さあ…
original_en: Well...
translated: Então...

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: …ああ
original_en: Right.
translated: Sim.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: レオーネ！？
original_en: Leone?
translated: Leone?

speaker: Leone
original_jp: オーブはオーディン様の物 <PART> ――
original_en: The orb belongs to Odin!
translated: O orbe pertence a Odin!

speaker: Leone
original_jp: 私にアリーシャを殺させないで
original_en: Don't make me kill Alicia!
translated: Não me faça matar Alicia!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …嘘だったんですね
original_en: So it was all a lie.
translated: Então era tudo mentira.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: （ こういう事だったのね シルメリア… ）
original_en: ( Is this what you warned me about, Silmeria? )
translated: ( Era disso que você me avisou, Silmeria? )

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: （ ごめんなさい 気づかなくて… ）
original_en: ( I'm sorry, I should have realized... )
translated: ( Desculpe, eu deveria ter percebido... )

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 貴様 どういう事だ！？
original_en: Leone, what're you doing?
translated: Leone, o que você está fazendo?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: …アーリィ・ヴァルキュリア！？
original_en: Hrist Valkyrie!?
translated: Hrist Valquíria!?

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 俺を騙してたのかッ！？
original_en: So you tricked me!?
translated: Então você estava me enganando!?

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: 神の務めに同行させてやったまでだ
original_en:
Be thankful you could assist in the
gods' plans.
translated: Agradeça por poder ajudar nos planos dos deuses.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: クソッ！
original_en: Thankful!?
translated: Agradecer!?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: よせ！
original_en: Stop!
translated: Pare!

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 早まるなッ！
original_en: No, wait!
translated: Não, espere!

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …どわッ！
original_en: Uaaagh!
translated: Uaaagh!

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 雇い主に明らかな非があれば俺は躊躇なく戒める…
original_en:
When I know my boss is gonna wrong me,
I don't hesitate to right it!
translated: Se meu chefe vai me passar a perna, não hesito em acertar as contas!

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: …傭兵だからな
original_en: That's the mercenary way.
translated: O jeito do mercenário.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: アリューゼよ 共に逝くか？
original_en: Arngrim, come with me.
translated: Arngrim, venha comigo.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: それが私からの謝礼だ
original_en: That will be your reward.
translated: Essa será a sua recompensa.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 冗談じゃねぇ… 誰が貴様なんかと…
original_en: You kidding me? Why would I go with you?
translated: Você está de brincadeira? Por que eu iria com você?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: アリューゼは私が預かるわ
original_en: We will take Arngrim.
translated: Vamos levar Arngrim.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 力で肉体をねじ伏せても心を縛り続ける事はできないはずよ
original_en:
You can subdue his flesh by force, but
you won't be able to bind his spirit.
translated: Você pode subjugar a carne dele pela força, mas não conseguirá prender o espírito dele.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: レナスならそれで納得するだろうが私はオーディン様の命を第一に考える
original_en:
Lenneth might agree to that, but I take
my orders from Odin, and no-one else.
translated: Lenneth poderia concordar, mas eu obedeço apenas a Odin.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: オーディンに反逆したエインフェリアは不死者となって今も敵対していると聞くわ
original_en:
You know the einherjar who rebelled
against Odin still opposes him as one of
the undead.
translated: Sabe que o einherjar que se rebelou contra Odin ainda o enfrenta como um dos mortos-vivos.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: お前が逃がしたからだろう シルメリア！
original_en:
Because you let him get away with it,
Silmeria!
translated: Porque você não o impediu, Silmeria!

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: たかが傭兵一人を御せぬほど私は甘くない…
original_en:
I'm not so soft that I can't handle one
mercenary.
translated: Não sou tão mole a ponto de não dar conta de um mercenário.

speaker: Hrist
original_jp: お前もオーディン様を怒らせる前に早くヴァルハラへ戻れ
original_en:
You'd best return to Valhalla quickly,
before you incur Odin's wrath.
translated: Vale mais você voltar logo para Valhalla, antes de incorrer na ira de Odin.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: やめ… ろ…
original_en: Stop it... No...!
translated: Pare... Não...!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …どうなってんだよ？
original_en: What the Hel just happened?
translated: O que diabos aconteceu?

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: すまない 私が迂闊だった…
original_en: Please, forgive me. I was reckless.
translated: Por favor, perdoem-me. Isso foi imprudente.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 言い訳にしかならないが 肉体という足かせがあっては対等に互りあえない
original_en:
I cannot fight her on even ground, not
while I am trapped inside this body.
translated: Não posso lutar em igualdade com ela, não enquanto estou presa neste corpo.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: あいつがアーリィだとわかっていてもどうしていいかわからなかった…
original_en:
Though I knew it was Hrist all along,
I didn't know what to do.
translated: Embora soubesse que era Hrist o tempo todo, eu não sabia o que fazer.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: それにオーブを手にした瞬間 おそらくアリーシャの思念で心が真っ白になった…
original_en:
The moment I held the orb, my mind went
blank <PART> ---- <PART> perhaps Alicia's thoughts took over.
translated:
No momento em que segurei o orbe, minha
mente ficou em branco <PART> ---- <PART> talvez a mente de Alicia
tomasse conta.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: だからって オタオタしないで取り返せばよかったじゃねえか！
original_en:
You could have at least grabbed the orb
back instead of just standing there!
translated: Pelo menos podia ter retomado o orbe em vez de ficar aí parada!

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: それは俺達も同じはずだ
original_en: There was nothing she could have done.
translated: Não havia nada que ela pudesse fazer.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: いざとなればオーブの力でこの場を焼き尽くす事もできたはずです…
original_en:
If she thought she had to, she would
have set the palace aflame with the orb.
translated: Se julgasse necessário, ela teria incendiado o palácio com o orbe.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: あなたの対応は決して間違っていませんでした
original_en:
You did all you could under the
circumstances.
translated: Você fez tudo o que podia naquela situação.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ごめんなさい
original_en: I'm so sorry.
translated: Sinto muito.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: （ アーリィはあなたを殺さなかった… ）
original_en: ( Hrist spared your life. )
translated: ( Hrist poupou a sua vida. )

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: （ …まだ打つ手はあるかもしれない ）
original_en: ( There might still be hope for us yet. )
translated: ( Ainda pode haver esperança para a gente. )

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: ドラゴンオーブを奪った今こそ 神々は本気でディパンを潰しに来るはずです
original_en:
Now that they have the orb, the gods
will soon come en masse to crush Dipan.
translated: Agora que têm o orbe, os deuses logo virão em massa esmagar Dipan.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: そこまで腹を括っているのなら俺は全力をかけてお供しよう
original_en:
If you're willing to take that risk, I
will protect you with all my might.
translated: Se você está disposta a correr esse risco, eu a protegerei com as minhas forças.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 俺も手伝うぜ！
original_en: That goes for me, too!
translated: O mesmo vale para mim!

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: （ 頼むわよ アリーシャ… ）
original_en: ( Have courage, Alicia. )
translated: ( Tenha coragem, Alicia. )

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …行きましょう！
original_en: Let's go.
translated: Vamos.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …ディパンへ乗り込んで敗者復活を挑もうってのか？
original_en:
You want us to slink back to Dipan and
just start all over?
translated: Voltar de rabo entre as pernas para Dipan e começar tudo de novo?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: それしか方法は残されていないでしょうシルメリア殿 <PART> ――
original_en:
I believe we have no other recourse.
Lady Silmeria?
translated: Acredito que não temos outra saída. Senhora Silmeria?

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 奴らはシルメリアの魂の召喚も望んでいるディパン潰しは同時に罠でもあるはずだ
original_en:
They are after Silmeria's soul. By
attacking Dipan, they'll also be setting
a trap.
translated: Eles querem a sua alma. Ao atacar Dipan, estarão armando uma armadilha.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: あえて引っかかる他あるまい…
original_en: We'll have to spring it then...
translated: Então teremos que cair nela mesmo...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: レオーネが…ヴァルキリーだったなんて…
original_en:
I can't believe it.
Leone was a valkyrie...
translated: Não acredito. Leone era uma valquíria...

speaker: Leone
original_jp: …人間がオーブに手を下す愚を防がねばこの先 貴様らはもっと困る事になる
original_en:
If I don't stop the orb from falling into
the hands of fool mortals, things will be
far worse.
translated: Se eu não impedir que o orbe caia nas mãos de tolos mortais, as coisas serão muito piores.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: 無茶しやがって…
original_en: Ever think before you act?
translated: Você não pensa antes de agir?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: アーリィ・ヴァルキュリアは本気でした
original_en: Hrist Valkyrie was determined.
translated: Hrist Valquíria estava determinada.
